question.html:
Crushed ice of mass 35 g at temperature −10 °C is placed in a warm room. The graph shows the variation of the temperature T of the ice with time t.

The specific heat capacity of ice is 2100 J kg−1 K−1.

a.i Show that the average rate at which thermal energy is being transferred into the ice is about 3 W. [2]

a.ii Estimate the specific latent heat of fusion of ice. [2]

b Between 4 minutes and 64 minutes solid ice and liquid water coexist at 0 °C. Explain how the internal energy of solid ice compares to that of an equal mass of liquid water. [2]
